name: the-shell-pro
description: A Ghost in the Shell-inspired technical publishing theme for Ghost 6.

show_comments.description: Show Ghost comments below technical posts

pgp_fingerprint.description: Public PGP key fingerprint shown in the footer colophon (leave empty to hide)

pgp_key_url.description: Optional link target for the footer PGP fingerprint (keyserver or .asc file)

social_github.description: Full GitHub profile URL (leave empty to hide the icon)

social_twitter.description: Full X/Twitter profile URL (leave empty to hide the icon)

social_bluesky.description: Full Bluesky profile URL (leave empty to hide the icon)

social_mastodon.description: Full Mastodon profile URL (leave empty to hide the icon)

social_linkedin.description: Full LinkedIn profile URL (leave empty to hide the icon)

social_discord.description: Discord server invite URL (leave empty to hide the icon)

social_hackthebox.description: Hack The Box profile URL (leave empty to hide the icon)

social_custom_url.description: One extra platform URL rendered with a generic link icon

social_custom_label.description: Accessible label for the extra platform icon (e.g. HackerOne)
